retrievalProfile.description: A dense, maximalist Victorian-era composition featuring hand-drawn ornamental lettering integrated with complex scrollwork, ribbons, and engraved medallions.
excludeWhen: flat design without depth or texture is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A highly detailed, layered composition reminiscent of 19th-century bank notes and showcards, utilizing dimensional lettering, intricate acanthus leaf filigree, and flowing ribbons to create a sense of historical craftsmanship.
coreVisualRelationships: Ribbons weaving through foreground and background layers
Medallions and clocks acting as secondary focal points
Dense ornamental borders framing the central typography
Stippled and hatched shading providing 3D depth
coreInvariants: Dimensional drop shadows on all primary lettering
Acanthus leaf and floral motifs in the corners

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale ornamental title dominates the center-left, with secondary text on flowing ribbons below and to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The oversized, highly decorated initial capital letters of the main title.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular flow starting from the top-left filigree, following the curve of the main title down to the ribbons, and back up through the right-side floral elements.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extremely limited; almost every surface is filled with texture, pattern, or ornament.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted parchment and aged paper tones (background)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (engraved lines and shadows)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Dusty blue and gold (ribbons and metallic highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between dark engraved lines and light gilded surfaces.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme stroke contrast with heavy vertical stems
Bifurcated (split) serifs and decorative spurs on mid-sections
Internal decorative patterns like pinstripes or floral fills
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial capitals feature extended swashes that morph into filigree
Descenders on 'y' and 'g' wrap around secondary elements
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Highly decorative display face paired with simpler, legible serif lettering on banners for contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and decorative spurs of the main title.
Appropriate for the secondary text on ribbons and medallions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dense Victorian-style frame with acanthus leaf filigree, engraved medallions, a pocket watch on the left, and flowing blank ribbons weaving through the center. Use a muted parchment color palette with charcoal engraving lines.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom ornamental lettering with bifurcated serifs and 3D hatched shadows to the center. Place secondary serif text along the curves of the ribbons using a hand-drawn engraved style.

verificationChecks: Ensure all lettering has a hand-engraved texture.
Check that ribbons realistically weave behind and in front of other elements.
Verify that the 3D extrusions on the main title follow a consistent light source.
Confirm the presence of fine cross-hatching in the shadows.

mustRedesign: Perfectly straight, non-warped text on ribbons

mustAchieve: Consistent engraving texture across all elements
avoid: Use of standard computer fonts without modification

postGenerationChecks: Is the lettering integrated into the filigree?
Does the shading use hatching rather than smooth gradients?
Are the ribbons properly warped to follow their physical curves?
Is the composition maximalist with minimal empty space?
Do the serifs exhibit Victorian 'Tuscan' characteristics?
recipe.reuseFormula: Victorian maximalism + engraved filigree + dimensional ornamental lettering + ribbon-bound typography.
